title: Introduce weighted-span-cohort-explorer and SLO tuning helper
author: Maya Thompson
description: Context: incident triage in the last month surfaced two recurring problems: (1) noisy SLO alerts triggered by low-volume expensive invocations and (2) lack of a practical UI for exploring span cohorts weighted by cost/latency rather than simple counts. Motivation: provide operators with a way to discover and inspect heavy hitters (token-cost and kernel-latency concentrated invocations) and to safely propose adjusted SLO thresholds that reduce noise without compromising customer impact detection. What this PR does: adds a backend cohort scoring service that computes weighted-span cohorts across sampled traces, a lightweight UI explorer to visualize cohorts and example sampled token traces, and an SLO Tuning Helper that proposes threshold adjustments and simulates alert noise reduction over historical windows. Checklist: - [x] cohort scoring service (server) - [x] REST endpoints for cohort queries and sample extraction - [x] frontend explorer panel (Cohort Explorer) - [x] SLO Tuning Helper UI with simulation view - [x] unit tests for cohort scoring and endpoint auth - [x] e2e smoke for UI flows - [x] dashboard JSON export for the new panels - [x] docs draft in docs/observability/cohort-explorer.md Related work: builds on ENG-1791 (sampling anchors) and reuses the sampled-trace-retention hooks from ENG-2012. Linked linear tasks ENG-2109 and PM-432 describe UX and operator acceptance criteria. Notes: endpoints are rate-limited and require the new "telemetry.read_cohorts" permission; cohort scoring defaults to a 7-day window and uses a tunable weight function (cost_weight=0.7, latency_weight=0.3) exposed in config. Rollout plan: feature-flag behind obs.cohort_explorer, enable for internal tenants for 2 weeks, then gradual rollout to SRE alpha. Risks: cohorting increases query CPU on the telemetry cluster; an autoscale patch is queued (ENG-2150).

merge_details: Merged by Leah Gomez on 2026-02-20 using squash-merge. Merge commit message: 'Introduce weighted span cohort explorer and SLO tuning helper — Maya Thompson (squash)'. Feature gated behind obs.cohort_explorer. Post-merge: kicked off rollout playbook and created ENG-2150 for autoscale improvements.
release_notes: Added: Cohort Explorer UI (observability) to surface weight-based span cohorts and sampled token traces; SLO Tuning Helper to simulate threshold changes and predict alert noise reduction. Ops: new telemetry.read_cohorts permission required for cohort access. Rollout: internal -> SRE alpha -> gradual customer rollout behind feature flag.
notes_for_oncall: If cohort scoring causes higher CPU on telemetry workers, the temporary mitigation is to disable obs.cohort_explorer feature flag and revert the scheduled scorer job via /internal/admin/jobs. See ENG-2150 for scaling action items.
testing_instructions: 1) enable feature flag obs.cohort_explorer for your tenant 2) hit /v1/obs/cohorts?window=7d&min_samples=5 and confirm cohorts return 3) open UI at /console/observability/cohort-explorer, inspect a cohort and open sample trace modal 4) run SLO Tuning Helper simulation for a 30-day window and verify proposed threshold reduces historical alerts in simulation output
author_notes: This PR is intentionally conservative: cohort scoring uses sampled traces and is rate-limited. Next steps (post-merge): add a streaming aggregator to produce daily cohort rollups and a compact index for sub-second cohort queries.
qa_status: manual smoke verified by SRE team; e2e smoke passing in CI
